title: Asahina Mafuyu — Memories Of Warm Affection〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Mafuyu's Room

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I'm finished with the mixing.
I'll send it over now...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Yuki.
I'll have a look once I'm done with what I'm doing now.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I was trying to find a good place to stop, but it ended up taking so long...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, I have practice in the morning tomorrow so I need to log off.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <If anything comes up, leave a message for me in the chat and I'll look at it tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I understand. Thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, I almost forgot.
Would you be okay with meeting in SEKAI tomorrow?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'd like to talk as a group about the video and lyrics for this song...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay, but I have to do homework so I'll probably be running late...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thank you.
Good night, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay, good night...>
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I feel sluggish, I think...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Maybe I stayed up too late last night.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Good morning, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you going to be practicing with Momoi this morning?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, we're taking a break today.
So, I was thinking about going to archery club for a change...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's great!
Shall we go together?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that but... Is everything okay, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh? Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's just, well...
You seem very tired.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I may've stayed up a little too late last night. My head does feel a little foggy...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mafuyu Asahina staying up too late?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm no different from anyone else, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I had quite a bit of homework to do as well, so I was busier than usual.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But I just feel a little sleepy is all.
I'm sure I'll be awake once I get in some exercise.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
You sort of reminded me of someone in my group just now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's also a diligent and hard-working person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So much so that she'll forget to take breaks in an effort to maintain her persona as a perfect idol...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She must be an incredible person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she is. Which is why I worry about her sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's a little uncanny how she and you share so many of the same qualities as one another.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This may sound strange, but it makes me wonder if someone is pushing themselves too hard...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But my friend says she isn't fatigued by what she does because it's all a part of being an idol...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you, Hinomori.
I appreciate the concern.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't feel overly fatigued or anything, but you say otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, but that may also be just me...
Oh, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Asahina, do you set aside time for yourself to relax?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Time to relax?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For example, surrounding yourself with the things you like or investing time in a hobby.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Or just finding time to let you be yourself and genuinely relax.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Time where I can be myself...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Asahina...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Again, I appreciate your concern, but I think I'm okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm surrounded by friends who will listen to me as well as teachers I can rely upon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That includes you too, Hinomori. My friend and valued clubmate.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I'd be glad to assist you in any way.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you, Hinomori.
